_comment: Apple Silicon leg (leso's MacBook Pro, M4 Max, 36 GB unified). run_mac.sh installs llama.cpp b10470 (same tag as the base rig's CUDA build) into ~/.cache/ccsync-eval and passes --model/--mmproj/--model-label/--ctx per model; this file only carries the host-level knobs. LLAMA_SERVER env or --llama-server overrides the binary path.
